hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. Intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, computes quotes using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into an Euler EVault, and withdraws output tokens from another EVault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta that overrides standard Uniswap v4 swap logic. Blocks native concentrated liquidity positions (beforeAddLiquidity reverts) and donations (beforeDonate reverts).
